note: Events/paths are relative to the album copy (<ALBUM>). error text is mutagen's and not part of the contract (error_text kept for reference). Lists of pairs keep insertion order.

scenarios.notes: One album-level field on a clean album; key casing (GENRE -> genre) and position.
Unchanged fields produce no diff; int year is str()'d; values stripped.
Every value equals the current tag (after strip): no save, files byte-identical.
Comparison is case-sensitive: a case-only difference is a diff and is written.
Nothing to do at all.
'' and None are skipped (no clearing possible); keys outside the album map ignored.
Filter runs before strip, so whitespace-only values are WRITTEN as empty strings.
Night Mix 3 has GENRE=[Downtempo, electronic]: first value matches, file untouched; other tracks get a single new value.
A differing value replaces every GENRE value with one string (no splitting).
UTF-8 values incl. astral-plane emoji; NFD album dir.
Per-track wins over album-level artist; tracknumber 4->3 renames '04 - ' to '03 - '.
Two-pass rename swaps 01<->02; non-numeric tracknumber is written but no rename; same number = no rename.
No recognisable prefix -> tags only; '04.flac' prefix+sep needs a separator char.

Track-number prefixes: a '1-05 - ' / '1.06_' disc-track prefix is replaced whole by the two-digit number and the separator kept; 100 and 123 are written unpadded ('100 - ', '123 - '); a non-integer '3.5' is written as a tag but renames nothing.
Track-number prefixes (malformed): '5/12' is not an int (no rename); Python's int() accepts '1_0' (10), '+6' (6) and the Arabic-Indic digit three (3), so those rename.
Diffs + planned renames reported, art_changed true, nothing saved, no sidecar.
Second identical apply is a no-op: no diffs, byte-identical.
Album without any cover: PICTURE added, cover.jpg created.
Existing embedded picture replaced by the re-encoded JPEG; tags changed too.
Embedded picture + cover.jpg present: both replaced.
Noisy RGB at an odd size: partial MCUs, high-frequency content.
RGBA -> RGB (alpha dropped); folder.jpg untouched.
P mode -> RGB. AppleDouble ._ file + notes.txt untouched; cover.jpg replaced.
L mode stays grayscale JPEG (depth 8).
Pillow opens I;16 but cannot write it as JPEG: original PNG bytes are embedded with mime image/jpeg and written to cover.jpg.
Header parses (lazy open) but decoding fails: original bytes kept.
Not an image: original bytes embedded, width/height/depth 0.
Three PICTURE blocks (types 0, 3, 4) + SEEKTABLE + APPLICATION: clear_pictures drops all three, one type-3 appended; other blocks keep order.
Tag-only write keeps all pictures in place.
ID3v2 prefix is kept (save(deleteid3=False)).
No VORBIS_COMMENT: add_tags() appends a fresh block (vendor 'Mutagen <ver>') at the end.
No PADDING: the metadata grows, default padding added, audio shifted.
No-op on a file without padding: not saved, so no padding is added.
Existing padding > 10 KiB + 1%: mutagen shrinks it to 1 KiB + 0.1%.
Entry without '=', non-ASCII key, empty key, invalid UTF-8 value and vendor, mixed-case duplicate GENRE keys: parsed with errors='replace' and re-serialised by mutagen.
An unreadable .flac yields a per-file error; the others are still written.
cover.png / cover.JPEG removed; folder.jpg and front.jpg kept. 'Cover.Png' is the same file as cover.png on a case-insensitive volume.
cover.JPG exists; on a case-insensitive volume it IS cover.jpg (samefile) and survives.
